one_line: Rashtrakuta emperor of Manyakheta, overseeing Deccan power and Indian Ocean trade observed by Sulaiman and Al-Masudi.

appearance.age_look: Late 30s, lean but regal build, athletic rather than bulky
appearance.face: Oval face with medium-deep brown Deccan complexion, sharp nose, high cheekbones, neatly trimmed short beard and moustache, calm observant eyes with slight upward tilt, default expression composed and thoughtful with a faint reassuring smile.
appearance.hair: Thick wavy black hair tied in a medium-length topknot at the crown, sides smoothly drawn back; a gold circlet-style Rashtrakuta crown with simple repoussé floral motifs sits low on the forehead, a narrow red cloth band running beneath it.
appearance.costume: He wears a long-sleeved, knee-length angavastra-style tunic in soft off-white cotton with a subtle woven border, over which is draped a rich deep-red silk uttariya from left shoulder across chest and around waist, secured with a wide gold belt decorated with small granulated studs; below, a finely pleated cream dhoti wrapped tightly and knotted at the front, falling to the ankles, with thin dark-green stripes along the edge, complemented by simple brown leather sandals; jewellery includes a single gold armlet with stylised makara motif on his right arm, two slim gold bangles on each wrist, small round gold stud earrings, and a long gold chain with a modest central pendant resting over the red sash, all rendered in clean anime lines but historically grounded in 9th-century Deccan royal attire.
appearance.signature: A finely crafted steel sword of Deccan type with a gently curving single-edged blade and a simple iron hilt wrapped in dark leather, sheathed in a plain brown scabbard with discreet brass fittings and carried at his left hip, symbolising royal authority rather than constant combat.

ref_desc: Amoghavarsha I has an oval medium-brown face with short beard, black topknot and gold circlet crown, wearing off-white tunic, deep-red silk sash, cream striped dhoti, gold jewellery and brown sandals, carrying a plain brown-scabbarded gently curving steel sword at his left hip.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of Amoghavarsha I standing in a dignified pose: an oval-faced, medium-brown Deccan ruler in his late 30s, with calm, thoughtful eyes, neatly trimmed short beard and moustache, and thick black hair pulled into a medium topknot. On his head sits a simple gold circlet crown with repoussé floral motifs and a narrow red cloth band beneath it. He wears a long-sleeved, knee-length off-white cotton tunic with a subtle woven border, over which a rich deep-red silk sash (uttariya) is draped from his left shoulder across his chest and around his waist, secured by a wide gold belt studded with small granulated details. His lower garment is a finely pleated cream dhoti, tightly wrapped and knotted in front, with thin dark-green stripes along its edges, falling down to his ankles. On his feet are plain brown leather sandals. Show his jewellery clearly: a single gold armlet with a stylised creature motif on his right arm, two slim gold bangles on each wrist, small round gold stud earrings, and a long gold chain with a modest central pendant resting on the red sash. At his left hip, depict a gently curving single-edged steel sword in a plain brown scabbard with discreet brass fittings, hanging from the belt as a symbol of royal authority. Use deep red, cream, off-white, dark green and gold as the dominant colours, and present him front-facing in a neutral, composed stance suitable for repeated redrawing.
